title: In bulk mode a click anywhere on a row ticks it instead of opening it
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory parts {Part-A}, {Part-B} and {Part-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-ROWTICK-01 to -03) are active and tracked at {Location-A}, with quantity 5 each.
  • Their part numbers start with {Prefix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-ROWTICK).
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Type {Prefix-A} in the Search box.
  3. Click the ⋮ actions menu button in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  4. Click Deactivate parts.
  5. Click the {Part-A} row on its description text.
  6. Click the {Part-A} row on its Category cell.
  7. Click the {Part-B} row on its Part Number cell.
  8. Click the checkbox at the left of the {Part-B} row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: The bulk bar shows "0 selected" and every row has an empty checkbox.
  • Step 5: The {Part-A} row is ticked and the bar reads "1 selected". No part dialog opens.
  • Step 6: The {Part-A} row is unticked and the bar reads "0 selected". No dialog opens.
  • Step 7: The {Part-B} row is ticked and the bar reads "1 selected". No dialog opens.
  • Step 8: The {Part-B} row is unticked and the bar reads "0 selected".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S2-R5, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.3 (Two rows ticked), 13 Oct copy. Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
